title: State of AI safety: as capabilities grow and models can monitor other models, issues like adversarial robustness persist and society is still not ready for AI (Boaz Barak/Windows On Theory)
summary: Boaz Barak / Windows On Theory: State of AI safety: as capabilities grow and models can monitor other models, issues like adversarial robustness persist and society is still not ready for AI — Here is a quick overview of my intuitions on where we are with AI safety in early 2026: — So far, we continue to see exponential improvements in capabilities.
